chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no problem with ornamenting the Qur'ans and the swords with gold and silver.

key_terms.الْمَصَاحِفِ: Plural of Musahaf, referring to copies of the Qur'an

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to decorate the Quran and swords with gold and silver?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that adorning the Qur'an and swords with gold and silver is permissible (la ba'sa), reflecting the Shia scholarly view that such embellishments honor the sacred text without constituting extravagance (israf). It highlights the cultural practice of beautifying religious artifacts, distinguishing between mere decoration and the prohibition of waste, a nuance often discussed in fiqh commentaries regarding the status of the Mushaf.
